content: Liba̱lab kweivaw son pwepway kweivaw
Mo akin liba̱lab kweivaw son pwepway kweivaw; peinan liba̱lab kweiboug bo ikous, o pwepway kweiboug bo ikous, o yol bo ikous.
Akin ven kweivaw, Yelusalem, ven kamnat, ibus im, meinoy neim walba̱lab Yowbad waseg, bo ikawyamis igwa̱vines, mamagina vin biguwa̱vin va̱gan kid beivays son namwan.

Mo aligen teitan aygan avakaein walba̱lab, ilana, “Magen, Yowbad siney gamag bisitans, peinan bimlavags angamag tasiyas, o towen siney tasiyas bisesus, biwes mitingis wamtes tasiyas, peinan kanig beikous, youd moumouvit beikous, va̱lam beikous, mamayuy beikous; youd babaw kweiboug bo beikous.”
Towen go nisin wanakabsis mo ilivan, ilana, “Youd babaw bo bavag kweivaw.” Wankuyeim mo ilivan, ilana, “Kulel, peinan livan towen mounid-wan.”
Mo idibakeig, ilana, “E, bo ikamat. Yey A son Z yey; yey nakabsilamaw son nakabiyokous. Kal yak ivag amdak mo basekeim amsoup, nilla̱tay mwamov silma̱nin, bukumoum. Maysan nag.
“Kukin bukutakayway waseg Seitan, youd babaw mo bukuyous, bukumlavag natug o yey muYowbad yey.

“Tasiyas gog tabwabweis, o tayyaweids, o takalba̱lebs, o tawa̱yins gamag, o taggeinawls, o tabbwagaws, o tamgamegs, tasiyas tayyaweids babaw bineis bisikes leg towen ika̱lawt kov son dakul muyamuy, mamagina sikanig vayuwein leg towen muyamuy waseg.”
Yelusalem kweivaw

Yowbad nataka̱yob teinim teiy nikokews abmavin bomanim bomey ika̱lawt youd kalbaleb kweinim kweiy, ven watinow kalbaleb-nen nakabiyokous silma̱nin; teitan mo idibakeig, ilana, “Kum bakatimlakeim vin mana̱wen beivays son La̱miy.”

E, kululuwag ikow inow wanakaew-o nakan koy singay avakaein, aveiyov, mo akin ven kamnat yagan Yelusalem ibus, meinoy neim walba̱lab Yowbad waseg, yakawanan Yowbad immiteil waseg, mamagin mititeilin dakul bwanabwein ikavivikawn ma̱wana ka̱las, o mamagina dakul yagan yasip magin ma̱wana gilas tonen.

Boul dakul nitoumis avakaein, aveiyov. Awkwedan gog sinawatan kweiy, koukwed katanok katanok Yowbad nataka̱yob teitan nises, o yagan nilel; koukwed yiges sinawatan kweiy, yiges min-Yisleil asikum sinawatan kweiy.
Wanuvid koukwed kweitoun, wabomat kweitoun, wa̱yals kweitoun, wayavat kweitoun.
Boul waseg kakol sinawatan kweiy; takaweins liva̱nen La̱miy sinawatan teiy nilel kakol waseg sinawatan kweiy.
Towen nakalivan soug wanaman kaligweg didumwal va̱gan bitakwen vayovan ven son awkwedan o boul-nen; tage kaligweg makaywen won goul-wan.
Ven towen palavas, vayovan son kopkopan katanok-wan. Nakaligweg waseg mo itakwen ven. Vayovan katanok tawsan lakatunim veit; vayovan mamagina Nugin. Vayovan son kopkopan sona vakaeinan katanok-wan.
Iwov boul vayovan, sinawatoun ovanim ovatan. Naman Yowbad nataka̱yob towen vayovan ma̱wana gamag naman.
Ven anaboul nitoumis dakul yagan yasip waseg, o ven goul-wan, ankakin gimagim ma̱wana gilas.

Ven towen kakolan ilabwes dakul babaw bwana̱bweins waseg, kweitan yasip, kwayuwein sapail, kwatounun kalisidon, kwavasin emla̱lid; kwanimen sadoniks, kweitan koneliyan, kwayuwein kalisolait, kwatounun beilil, kwavasin topas, kwanimen kalaysopaleis, kweitan tekwous, kweiyuwein amitis. Dakul tasiyas baba̱wan sinawatan akweiy, askakin singaya bwanabwein.
Awkwedan ven lap sinawatan kweiy, kweitan koukwed katanok lap, kweitan koukwed kweitan lap; babiweis lap sinawatan kweiy. Vitakon ven goul tonen, mamagina gilas, gimagim seikwan.
Ven towen waseg ta-akin Yowbad nabunatum tapwa̱loul silma̱nin; nag. Peinan towen Tatawtoun Yowbad son La̱miy mamagina buntuman tapwa̱loul tasiyas.
Ven towen nag ivag sivinan ka̱las o tibukon va̱gan bimteilis; nag. Peinan Yowbad nakamnat bo ivanoum, imteil ven; o La̱miy mamagina lamp ven towen silma̱nin.
Ven babaw gimgilis binounas mititeilin towen waseg. Guyawaw ven watinow binawes sikamnat ven towen waseg.
Wuda̱yam nag bikatibagus ven towen awkwedan, o nag beivag boug.
Ven babaw gimgilis bikawes yakawanes o bulages binawes ven towen walba̱lab.
O ven towen nag beisiw aveiyag bwaboum o kalbaleb o yaweid; nag. Misinaka tasiyas yiges nilel La̱miy wanabuk mwamov silma̱nin.
